title: Home Row Everything
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Song Title: Home Row Everything
Suno v5.5 Style: Uplifting motivational cyber-future-trap anthem, fast rhythmic verses that feel like fingers flying across the keyboard, powerful male lead + huge group chant on chorus, crisp 808s, sharp hi-hats, soaring supersaws, subtle pulsing low-end tone, triumphant and addictive, pure keyboard flow energy.
[Intro]
Mouse pushed to the side, collecting dust
Hands on the keys, this is where we trust
asdf jkl; — the center of it all
Everything you need is right under your palms
[Verse 1]
h j k l moving, never touch the arrows
Never break the rhythm, never leave the flow
i to insert, escape back to command
Modal power sitting in the palm of your hand
Word by word with w and b
Line by line with 0 and $ — so easy
[Pre-Chorus]
History at your fingertips
Completion with a tab
Once you lock into the home row
You’ll never want to grab
[Chorus]
Home row everything
Never touch the mouse
Stay in the zone, let the keyboard do the talking
Home row everything
Speed is in your hands
Once you feel it, you’ll never go back
Home row everything
This is where we live
Fast, clean, focused — pure keyboard bliss
[Verse 2]
Panes and windows split without a click
Fuzzy find anything in half a second
Delete words, lines, blocks in a flash
All without your hand ever leaving the stash
Up and down through every command you’ve typed
The keyboard becomes an extension of your mind
[Bridge – Chant]
No reaching left, no reaching right
Everything important stays in sight
Home row is home, home row is power
This is how the fastest operators devour
Every task, every file, every line
Done from the center — feeling so fine
[Final Chorus – Bigger]
Home row everything
Never touch the mouse
Stay in the zone, let the keyboard do the talking
Home row everything
Speed is in your hands
Once you feel it, you’ll never go back
Home row everything
This is where we thrive
Keyboard flow state — fully alive
[Outro – Fast chant]
Home row… everything…
Home row… everything…
h j k l… w b… 0 $…
Tab complete… history repeat…
Stay home. Stay fast. Stay free.
